summary: Fixed in 22a91d12 in the same session it was found. Root cause was WHERE the marker lived, not a missing re-check: it is a claim about site-packages, so it belongs beside the interpreter that owns them. Anchored on getPythonBin(). Verified live on this machine - after the reinstall the marker was ABSENT at the new path (old code would have skipped again), the curated install ran, 80 packages landed, and scripts/engine-floor-check.mjs went from 17 missing to 0 (1877 class_types, 171/171). Invariant pinned in tests/curated-python-deps.test.cjs: beside the interpreter, never ENGINE_ROOT, and on win32 inside the tree the wipe removes.
